figures.finding: No agreement or minimum for a director is set in the US Minor Outlying Islands, which have no permanent inhabitants; filming on the island refuges is allowed only by a federal permit (50 CFR 27.71, under 43 CFR part 5), and the US federal minimum wage and overtime rules (FLSA ss. 206-207) reach work on Wake Island and Johnston Island, not on the other islands.

The provisions of sections 206 , 207 , 211 , and 212 of this title shall not apply with respect to any employee whose services during the workweek are performed in a workplace within a foreign country or within territory under the jurisdiction of the United States other than the following: … American Samoa; Guam; Wake Island; Eniwetok Atoll; Kwajalein Atoll; and Johnston Island.

figures.finding: The DGA's Basic Agreement reaches the US Minor Outlying Islands: its section 17-201 applies it to work on motion pictures based in and performed in the United States, its territories and dependencies included, and the Department of the Interior holds the US Minor Outlying Islands US territories (Baker, Howland, Jarvis, Johnston, Kingman, Midway, Navassa and Wake unincorporated, Palmyra incorporated). The 2026 Memorandum of Agreement carries the 2023 agreement into the 2026 one (1 July 2026 to 30 June 2030) and leaves 17-201 as it was (its geographical part only reissues a bulletin and amends Sideletter No. 31), so a director there works on the DGA's terms, set as the US's are.

figures.applies: The US Minor Outlying Islands, a director engaged by a DGA signatory, as the life's company is held to be in the US (the engine's reading: the life's company signs where a guild lets a producer sign). A non-signatory's director there has no guild terms; the game doesn't model one.

sources.said: The provisions of this BA shall apply to work on motion pictures based in the United States and performed in the United States (including its territories and dependencies) and Canada; provided, however, that the provisions of this BA shall also apply to work performed by any Employee employed by the Employer in the United States, to direct, or to be a UPM or an Assistant Director or Associate Director on a motion picture based outside the United States (including its territories and dependencies).

The terms of the 2023 BA (including all sideletters) shall be incorporated in the Directors Guild of America Basic Agreement of 2026, except as provided below and subject to conforming changes. … The term of the 2026 BA and the 2026 FLTTA shall be for four (4) years, commencing on July 1, 2026 to and including June 30, 2030. … 4. International Jurisdiction (U-4) A. Geographical Application (U-4.A.) … Modify Sideletter No. 31 to the Basic Agreement as follows:

territory An unincorporated United States insular area, of which there are currently thirteen, three in the Caribbean (Navassa Island, Puerto Rico and the United States Virgin Islands) and ten in the Pacific (American Samoa, Baker Island, Guam, Howland Island, Jarvis Island, Johnston Atoll, Kingman Reef, Midway Atoll, the Northern Mariana Islands and Wake Atoll). … An incorporated United States insular area, of which only one exists currently, Palmyra Atoll.
